purpose: Teach: オペラ/ラップ/スカウト/モバイル/プログラミング/思い切り/新車/停車

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ヨーロッパ旅行で、本気で、絶対、オペラ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見たわよ
lines.en: Aoi, when you went to Europe, you absolutely had to see an opera—you were completely serious about it.
lines.style: Warm, knowing tone. Light laugh underneath. Speaking as someone who remembers a specific story. Animated but grounded, not performing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、ラップ、絶対、ミュージック、絶対、最近、絶対、聴いてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and lately you've been seriously into rap music—you're really into it, aren't you?
lines.style: Matching her energy but softer. A gentle tease, like she's noticing something Aoi wouldn't necessarily volunteer. Quick pace, genuinely curious underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、スカウト、絶対、されそうな、絶対、人気店、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、思うわ
lines.en: Your shop is becoming the kind of place that could get scouted—it's really that popular now, I think.
lines.style: Sincere admiration. Slower, letting each word land. No exaggeration—just genuine recognition of something real. Soft certainty in the tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、モバイル、絶対、注文、絶対、システム、絶対、入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you installed a mobile ordering system too—you're really building something here.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact. Quick pivot, like it's the next obvious thing she's noticed. Approving without fussing over it. Practical warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、プログラミング、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、お願いしたって
lines.en: I heard you even asked your dad to handle the programming for the shop.
lines.style: Thoughtful pace. A small observation landing softly. Voice trails slightly, like she's connecting dots about Aoi and her father. Gentle, not intrusive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、思い切り、絶対、楽しんで、絶対、お店、絶対、運営、絶対、しているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're really throwing yourself into running that shop—you genuinely love it, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, steady tone. Genuine question underneath, not rhetorical. Pace slows slightly. Recognition of something deep and real in how Aoi moves through her work.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお父さん、本気で、絶対、新車、絶対、買ったって、聞いたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard your dad bought a new car, by the way.
lines.style: Quick, conversational. Light shift in energy—a new thread, not heavy. Animated but easy, like she's passing along a piece of news with a smile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の前、本気で、絶対、停車、絶対、禁止、絶対、看板、絶対、立てたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: So you put up a no-parking sign right in front of the shop for him, didn't you?
lines.style: Understated amusement. Quick, almost dry. A small laugh in the delivery. The satisfaction of a practical solution, with affection underneath.
